Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-134
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_2 when using tools use this path.

messages.content: 3. Now let's create the LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation:

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_2/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_zhou.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0
fix_modify 3 energy yes

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz xy xz yz
thermo 1

# Perform elastic constant calculation
# Initial strain
variable d1 equal ${up}
variable d2 equal ${down}

# xx strain
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale ${d1} y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# yy strain
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale 1.0 y scale ${d1} z scale 1.0 remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# zz strain
fix 1 all deform 1 x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0 z scale ${d1} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# yz strain
fix 1 all deform 1 yz ${d1} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# xz strain
fix 1 all deform 1 xz ${d1} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# xy strain
fix 1 all deform 1 xy ${d1} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
unfix 1

# Output elastic tensor
print "Elastic tensor components (in GPa):"
variable C11 equal "(v_pxx-v_press)*0.0001"
variable C22 equal "(v_pyy-v_press)*0.0001"
variable C33 equal "(v_pzz-v_press)*0.0001"
variable C12 equal "0.5*(v_pxy)*0.0001"
variable C13 equal "0.5*(v_pxz)*0.0001"
variable C23 equal "0.5*(v_pyz)*0.0001"

print "C11 = ${C11}"
print "C22 = ${C22}"
print "C33 = ${C33}"
print "C12 = ${C12}"
print "C13 = ${C13}"
print "C23 = ${C23}"

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal "(${C11}+${C22}+${C33}+2*(${C12}+${C13}+${C23}))/9"
print "Bulk modulus (GPa) = ${B}""}
